Q Is the paper's Fig. self_organized_process (§Composition of the cellular interface) executable rather than merely drawn -- does the `fig08-runnable` composite actually demonstrate that a cellular interface EMERGES when molecular processes are compositionally coupled so they maintain one another (metabolism synthesizes the components the membrane and replication need, containment/expression maintain the pools metabolism needs), so that the coupled system holds a sustained, far-from-equilibrium balance rather than each process running down independently?

The Study
Design
Evidence
Assurance
Decision

Claim

Fig. self_organized_process is executable: the `fig08-runnable` composite couples containment, metabolism, gene expression, replication, diffusion, and mass-action reactions over ten shared flat building-block pools, and over a deterministic 40-tick run it demonstrates the caption's exact principle -- the coupled processes maintain one another into a sustained, far-from-equilibrium balance (every pool strictly positive and bounded; template/catalytic pools genes, energy, metabolites, nucleic_acids hold steady within 25% while structural material membrane, proteins, enzymes is net-produced), and that balance is a property of the COUPLING, not of any pool in isolation: removing metabolism starves its downstream metabolite pool toward zero and freezes energy at its seed, and removing gene expression freezes the enzyme pool metabolism depends on and drops metabolism's metabolite output. This is a toy-real didactic demonstration, not a calibrated model; its rigorous cousin is the `autopoiesis` study in `draft-to-living-cell`.

This study makes Fig. self_organized_process runnable. The paper's §Composition of the cellular interface asks how molecular processes give rise to a cellular interface: at the molecular level, reactions, transport, and template-directed synthesis act on shared variables, and "a cellular interface emerges when these processes are compositionally coupled so that they maintain one another" -- membrane structure depends on metabolism that synthesizes lipids, metabolism depends on containment to maintain concentrations, and template-directed synthesis maintains the molecular components that realize these processes over time (caption a: self-organized processes -- autocatalysis, membrane formation, template replication -- combine into a self-maintaining organization; caption b: a minimal cell composition diagram -- metabolism, containment, replication supporting each other through shared components). The `fig08-runnable` composite is the executable form of caption b. It wires the six minimal-cell processes -- containment (assembles membrane from lipids), metabolism (turns enzymes + nutrients into metabolites + energy), gene expression (translates genes + amino_acids into proteins + enzymes), replication (copies genes by spending energy, returns nucleic_acids), diffusion (metabolite turnover), and mass-action reactions (interconvert building blocks) -- over ten FLAT scalar building-block pools they all share (membrane, lipids, metabolites, nutrients, amino_acids, nucleic_acids, enzymes, proteins, genes, energy). Because the processes share those pools, none stands alone: gene expression makes the enzymes metabolism needs, metabolism makes the energy replication spends, replication grows the gene template expression reads. This is the paper's closure condition made concrete -- each process's outputs sustain the inputs the others depend on. Run 40 ticks through the process-bigraph engine (deterministic ODE handlers, no RNG), the coupling holds: every one of the observed pools stays strictly positive and bounded (nothing collapses to zero, nothing explodes -- the largest pool, membrane, reaches only 2.2). The catalytic/template pools hold a sustained steady balance (genes 1.00 -> 1.07, energy 0.50 -> 0.58, metabolites 0.30 -> 0.33, nucleic_acids 0.30 -> 0.29; each drifts < 25% over the second half of the run) while the cell's structural material is net-produced (membrane 0.2 -> 2.2, proteins 0.30 -> 0.88, enzymes 0.30 -> 0.50). That the balance is MAINTAINED by the coupling, not intrinsic to any one pool, is shown by opening the loop: knock metabolism out and its downstream metabolite pool collapses toward zero (0.33 -> 0.011) while energy, whose only source is metabolism, freezes exactly at its 0.5 seed; knock gene expression out and the enzyme pool metabolism depends on freezes exactly at its 0.3 seed, dragging metabolism's own metabolite output down (0.33 -> 0.23). The sustained balance is the composite maintaining one another's inputs, not each process coasting on its own reserves. This is a didactic, toy-real realization: the pools, rate constants, and yields are hand-chosen so the coupled balance is legible over a 40-tick run, NOT calibrated to a named organism, metabolite, or literature flux. Its rigorous cousin is the `autopoiesis` study in the `draft-to-living-cell` investigation, which realizes the same self-maintenance claim at higher fidelity; this study's job is only to show that the figure's specific caption -- coupled processes maintaining one another into a self-sustaining whole -- runs and holds under test.

Test

Run the `fig08-runnable` composite (six coupled processes -- containment, metabolism, gene expression, replication, diffusion, mass-action reactions -- over ten shared flat scalar building-block pools) for its declared 40 ticks through the process-bigraph engine, and measure whether the coupled processes maintain one another into a sustained, far-from-equilibrium balance: every pool positive and bounded, the catalytic/template pools holding steady while structural material is net-produced. Then open the maintenance loop with two process knockouts (metabolism; gene expression) and measure whether the downstream shared pools each depend on collapse -- showing the balance is a property of the coupling, not of any pool in isolation.

Result

Over a deterministic 40-tick run the `fig08-runnable` composite holds the coupled balance: every observed pool stays strictly positive (smallest minimum metabolites 0.267) and bounded (largest value membrane 2.2), the catalytic/template pools hold a sustained steady balance (second-half drift genes 0.034, energy 0.083, metabolites 0.203, nucleic_acids 0.000 -- all < 0.25), and the structural material is net-produced (membrane 0.2 -> 2.2, proteins 0.30 -> 0.88, enzymes 0.30 -> 0.50). Two process knockouts confirm the balance is a property of the coupling: removing metabolism starves its downstream metabolite pool (0.33 -> 0.011) and freezes energy exactly at its 0.5 seed, and removing gene expression freezes the enzyme pool metabolism depends on exactly at its 0.3 seed and drops metabolism's metabolite output (0.33 -> 0.23). Fig. self_organized_process is executable -- the caption's self-maintaining composition runs and holds under test. This is a toy-real didactic demonstration; its rigorous cousin is the `autopoiesis` study in the `draft-to-living-cell` investigation.

Conclusion logic — gate decision

✓ If primary tests pass:
Implementation: fig08-runnable.composite.json builds and runs its declared 40-tick horizon through the process-bigraph engine, deterministically.
Empirical validation: The caption''s self-maintaining-composition principle is demonstrated at the toy-real (uncalibrated) level -- coupled processes holding a sustained far-from-equilibrium balance, with two knockouts confirming the balance depends on the coupling -- rather than asserted from a static diagram.
✗ If primary tests fail:
Diagnose:
  • a pool collapses to zero or explodes (a rate constant or yield is mistuned, breaking the balance)
  • a template pool drifts more than 25% over the second half (the coupling no longer settles to a sustained balance within the run)
  • structural material is not net-produced (containment/expression yields too low)
  • a knockout fails to move its downstream pool (the shared-pool wiring is broken, so the processes are not actually coupled through the pools they should share)
Block downstream: any figure study that reuses the shared-flat-pool coupling pattern to demonstrate compositional self-maintenance

Conclusion

Claims

  • Fig. self_organized_process is executable. The fig08-runnable composite couples containment, metabolism, gene expression, replication, diffusion, and mass-action reactions over ten shared flat building-block pools, and over a deterministic 40-tick run it demonstrates the caption's exact principle -- the coupled processes maintain one another into a sustained, far-from-equilibrium balance rather than each running down independently.
  • The maintained balance holds: every observed pool stays strictly positive and bounded (smallest minimum metabolites 0.267, largest value membrane 2.2), the catalytic/template pools genes, energy, metabolites, nucleic_acids drift < 25% over the second half of the run, and the structural material membrane, proteins, enzymes is net-produced (membrane 0.2 -> 2.2, proteins 0.30 -> 0.88, enzymes 0.30 -> 0.50).
  • That balance is a property of the coupling, not of any pool in isolation. Removing metabolism starves its downstream metabolite pool (0.33 -> 0.011) and freezes energy at its 0.5 seed; removing gene expression freezes the enzyme pool metabolism depends on at its 0.3 seed and drops metabolism's metabolite output (0.33 -> 0.23). The loop closes both ways.

Evidence

  • CLOSURE-SUSTAINS-ITSELF-EVERY-POOL-POSITIVE -- all seven pool minima > 0 (smallest metabolites 0.267)
  • CLOSURE-IS-BOUNDED-NOTHING-EXPLODES -- largest value over the run is membrane 2.2
  • TEMPLATE-POOLS-HOLD-A-STEADY-BALANCE -- second-half drift genes 0.034, energy 0.083, metabolites 0.203, nucleic_acids 0.000 (all < 0.25)
  • STRUCTURAL-MATERIAL-IS-NET-PRODUCED -- membrane 0.20 -> 2.20, proteins 0.30 -> 0.88, enzymes 0.30 -> 0.50
  • METABOLISM-KNOCKOUT-STARVES-DOWNSTREAM-POOLS -- metabolites 0.33 -> 0.011, energy frozen at 0.5
  • GENE-EXPRESSION-SUSTAINS-THE-ENZYMES-METABOLISM-DEPENDS-ON -- enzymes frozen at 0.30, metabolites 0.33 -> 0.23
  • RUNS-DEFAULT-N-STEPS -- 41 emitted rows == 40 + 1

Limitations

  • fig08-runnable is a didactic, toy-real composite: the ten pools, the six processes' rate constants and yields are hand-chosen to make the coupled balance legible over 40 ticks, not calibrated to a named organism, metabolite, enzyme, or literature flux.
  • The composite integrates over flat scalar pools, not spatial fields or a real membrane geometry; "containment" is a scalar membrane-assembly ODE, so the self-maintenance shown is compositional (shared-pool coupling), not spatial.
  • The rigorous cousin is the autopoiesis study in the draft-to-living-cell investigation; this study does not restate that study's numbers as its own.

Next steps

  • Compare against the autopoiesis cousin to see the same self-maintenance claim at higher fidelity.
  • Optionally push a knockout toward full viability collapse to connect this figure's closure to the §Disintegration level-shift studied elsewhere in the paper.

Plan & assumptions

Key assumptions

  • The `fig08-runnable` composite is a **didactic, toy-real** realization of the figure -- small, illustrative, built to look like Fig. self_organized_process b and play forward. The ten building-block pools, the six processes' rate constants (assembly_rate 0.05, k_cat 0.1, k_expr 0.08, k_rep 0.015, turnover_rate 0.08, k_react 0.06), and the yields are hand-chosen so the coupled balance is legible over 40 ticks. They are NOT calibrated to a named organism, metabolite, enzyme, or literature flux.
  • The composite integrates over FLAT scalar pools (membrane, lipids, metabolites, ...), not spatially resolved fields or a real membrane geometry. "Containment" here is a scalar membrane-assembly ODE, not a diffusion barrier maintaining a concentration gradient in space. The self-maintenance shown is compositional (shared-pool coupling), not spatial.
  • The handlers are deterministic ODEs with no random seed, so every number below is exactly reproducible run to run; there is no stochasticity to average over.
  • The mutual-maintenance loop is demonstrated by process knockout (deleting a process from the state), which drives that process's contribution to its shared pools to zero. This isolates each coupling edge but is a structural intervention on the composite, not a perturbation of a physical rate.
  • The rigorous cousin is the `autopoiesis` study in the `draft-to-living-cell` investigation; this study does not restate that study's numbers or fidelity as its own.

Limitations

What this study explicitly does NOT validate (prevents overclaim).

  • `fig08-runnable` is a didactic, toy-real composite -- the ten building-block pools, the six processes' rate constants (assembly_rate 0.05, k_cat 0.1, k_expr 0.08, k_rep 0.015, turnover_rate 0.08, k_react 0.06), and the yields are hand-chosen so the coupled balance is legible over a 40-tick run, NOT calibrated to a named organism, metabolite, enzyme, or literature flux.
  • The composite integrates over flat scalar pools, not spatially resolved fields or a real membrane geometry; "containment" is a scalar membrane-assembly ODE rather than a diffusion barrier maintaining a spatial gradient. The self-maintenance demonstrated is compositional (shared-pool coupling), not spatial.
  • The handlers are deterministic ODEs with no random seed, so the numbers are exact and reproducible but carry no stochastic-robustness claim; there is no ensemble to average over.
  • The mutual-maintenance loop is demonstrated by process knockout (deleting a process from the composite state), a structural intervention that zeroes a process's contribution to its shared pools -- it isolates each coupling edge cleanly but is not a physical rate perturbation.
  • The rigorous cousin is the `autopoiesis` study in the `draft-to-living-cell` investigation, which realizes the same self-maintenance claim at higher fidelity. This study demonstrates only that this figure's specific caption runs and holds under test; it does not restate the cousin's numbers or fidelity as its own.
